first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person near the center of the image who is wearing a light-colored hat, has long dark hair beside the shoulders, and is wearing a light-colored sleeveless top, dark long pants, and light-colored shoes.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The light-brown quadruped adjacent to Person A on the image-right side, with its raised head, torso, and the outlines of slender legs below visible.

entities.name: Golden Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The golden to yellow-brown short grassland covering the foreground and most of the middle ground.

entities.name: Mixed Woodland Belt
entities.identification: The dark-green to yellowish-brown-green woodland distributed along the far edge of the grassland, with interspersed narrow pointed and broad rounded crowns of varying heights.

entities.name: Pale Blue Sky
entities.identification: The pale blue sky area above the woodland, with no obvious cloud layer visible.

entities.name: Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch
entities.identification: The light gray-yellow, low, sparsely grassed ground patch with irregular edges beneath the feet of Person A and Animal A.

entities.name: Open-Sided Shed
entities.identification: The shed-like structure partially visible at the extreme image-left edge in the final portion, showing a sloping roof and support posts below.
